single_lesion.lost_information: Explicit singleton count is not encoded by lesion morphology cues.

two_lesions.lost_information: Explicit count of two is lost.

few_lesions.lost_information: Small cardinality is not a cue dimension.

multiple_lesions.lost_information: Multiplicity is not represented by lesion shape/color states.

dense_lesion_distribution.lost_information: Density is distinct from lesion type; count and density can overlap.

small_lesion_size.lost_information: Size independent of dark color is not preserved; small_dark_spots only preserves a conjunction.

medium_lesion_size.lost_information: Medium size/range is absent from the ontology.

large_lesion_size.lost_information: Size independent of irregular shape is lost; partly overlaps large_irregular_blotches.

mixed_lesion_sizes.lost_information: Within-image size range is not represented.

scattered_distribution.lost_information: Dispersion is not a cue dimension.

clustered_distribution.lost_information: Lesion clustering is not a cue dimension.

localized_distribution.lost_information: Restricted spatial extent is not represented.

diffuse_discoloration.lost_information: Diffuse discoloration differs from lesion-border diffuseness.

uneven_distribution.lost_information: Uneven spatial distribution is not preserved.

asymmetric_distribution.lost_information: Image-relative side asymmetry is lost; orientation may be incidental.

margin_associated.lost_information: Location of color/lesion changes at margins is not encoded by leaf curling.

tip_associated.lost_information: Tip location is distinct from lesion morphology.

central_associated.lost_information: Leaf-central location is lost; lesion centers must be excluded.

upper_leaf_associated.lost_information: Upper-leaf location is lost; image orientation can affect wording.

vein_associated.lost_information: Vein-associated location is distinct from mottling itself.

single_large_contiguous_lesion.lost_information: Contiguity and singleton organization are not explicitly encoded.

many_discrete_lesions.lost_information: Discreteness requires explicit wording; not inferred from spots or scattered.

merging_coalescing_lesions.lost_information: Coalescence is not preserved by the resulting blotch cue alone.

diffuse_discoloration_without_discrete_l.lost_information: Diffuse/patch organization plus explicit absence of discrete lesions; text-only relation.

green_to_yellow_gradient.lost_information: Directional color transition is lost even when yellow/mosaic cues are present.

green_to_dark_gradient.lost_information: Directional green-to-dark transition is not encoded.

patterns: \b(?:dark brown to black|dark brown and black|dark necrotic|dark)\s+discoloration\b
dark_brown_black_discoloration.lost_information: Broad discoloration color is not identical to small dark spots or dark borders.

pale_gray_discoloration.lost_information: Non-center pale/gray discoloration is not a pale lesion center.

unpatterned_light_dark_green_contrast.lost_information: Green tonal contrast without positive mottling wording; existing mosaic cue overlaps.

dark_lesion_centers.lost_information: Dark centers are distinct from dark borders and pale centers.

light_brown_lesion_margins.lost_information: Lighter lesion margins are not dark lesion borders.

diffuse_lesion_borders.lost_information: Border sharpness is not preserved by dark-border color.

rough_surface_texture.lost_information: Surface texture is distinct from shape deformation and colored surface growth.

raised_surface_texture.lost_information: Surface relief is not encoded by leaf deformation alone.

dry_surface_texture.lost_information: Explicit dryness is not a deformation state.

smooth_flat_surface.lost_information: Positive smooth/flat texture is distinct from a lack of deformation mention.

method.aggregation: present > uncertain > not_mentioned across fields; negative matches retained as rejected evidence.
method.loss_unit: One image x feature with present/uncertain state; repeated field mentions counted once.
method.loss_scope: Information content not independently recoverable from existing 14 cue states; partial overlaps documented, not declared disjoint.
method.ranking: Descending coverage, then lower redundancy risk, lower ambiguity risk, descending descriptive class-rate range, name.
method.recommendation_rule: strong: >=6/30, low redundancy, non-high ambiguity; possible: >=2/30, non-high redundancy and ambiguity; otherwise do_not_add_yet. No labels or performance metrics used.
method.family_counts: Nonexclusive; related features and cross-family overlaps can double-count information units.
excluded_existing_content: Curling, narrowing, deformation and mottling themselves are already represented.
Pale centers, dark borders, halos and rings themselves are already represented.
method.extra_family: G records visible surface texture beyond the requested focus families A–F.

cautions: This is a text information-loss inventory and candidate review, not a newly implemented representation.
Frequent does not mean predictive; class-varying does not mean causal; no field robustness claim.
not_mentioned includes rejected negatives and unmatched text; it never means biological absence.
Counts depend on explicit vocabulary, bounded regex scope, and inherited V2 wording, not independent image verification.
Spatial association does not necessarily mean spatial predominance; reduced-location mentions are weak or rejected.
No discreteness or contiguity is inferred from the words scattered, lesions, or necrotic areas alone.
Sizes partially overlap compound existing cues; tonal contrast overlaps mottling and is a high-risk proposal.
Class profiles use five examples each. Ranking and recommendation are transparent descriptive triage, not validation.
Negative lists and long-distance hedges can be over-scoped or missed; evidence and rejected matches are retained.
